name: skill-coach
description: Before each prompt is sent, finds the skills that fit it (installed ones, plus plugins you could install) and offers a clearer prompt that uses them, for you to edit, send or skip.

model.title: Model
model.description: The model that reviews each prompt. Haiku is the fastest and cheapest. Sonnet and Opus write better prompts but are slower and use more of your plan.

suggestInstalls.title: Suggest plugins to install
suggestInstalls.description: Also look at plugins you could install from your marketplaces and the plugin directory, and say when one would help.

minChars.title: Shortest prompt to check
minChars.description: Prompts shorter than this many characters are sent without a check.
